project_index.note: Declarations and syntactic calls only; imports do not prove framework use or resolved call relationships.

Secrets.note: Candidates are not tested against services. Placeholders are suppressed. False positives remain possible.

Python.note: Statement-order local flow, aliases and Flask input sources. Branches merge conservatively; bounded plain same-file function calls (depth 4, 100 expansions/file); no execution or runtime reachability proof.

JavaScript.note: Tree-sitter statement-order local variable and sanitizer context; comments and string contents do not trigger code rules. TypeScript and interprocedural data flow are not supported.

Java.note: Tree-sitter local statement-order flow and declared types; no interprocedural flow, Java build or code execution. Deserialization filters require manual review.

HTML.note: HTML and inline JavaScript are parsed without rendering, executing scripts or fetching resources.

Configuration.note: Literal configuration inspection only; environment overrides and runtime behavior are not evaluated. JSON/YAML locations are file-level line 1.

Dependencies.note: Only exact declared or locked versions are queried; unsupported formats are explicitly listed; no dependency installation, transitive resolution or guessing of version ranges. Unknown advisory severity is Informational. Private package names/versions are sent to OSV only when enabled.
